messages:
Ivy - acct_exec: Customer's procurement emailed back: their security team needs a short CAIQ answer for key rotation evidence during a Dedicated POC. They want to know what logs we can produce and who verifies rotation events.
Ethan - sales_engineer: Quick answer: For BYOK Dedicated POC, customer controls rotation; Redwood can export KMS access logs that show rotation events (if the customer's KMS provides those events). For platform-managed keys in Hosted, Redwood rotates per our policy and can provide rotation schedule and audit trail extracts.
Rina - security: Add gradation: if customer wants signed attestations of rotation, that's an add-on. We can provide KMS access audit entries and operational logs that show the apply/deploy events. If using cloud KMS (AWS KMS/GCP KMS), the customer's cloud account has the canonical rotation records.
Samira - solutions_eng: Can we include a CAIQ blurb: 'Redwood can provide rotation evidence in the form of KMS audit logs and change manifests. For customer-managed KMS, canonical rotation records are maintained by the customer's cloud provider; Redwood will provide exported access logs and related configuration snapshots for the POC window.'
Ivy - acct_exec: Perfect. Also procurement wants a one-liner we can put in the SOW about who signs off on rotation for POC acceptance criteria.
Ethan - sales_engineer: SOW one-liner: 'POC acceptance: the customer is responsible for validating encryption key rotation for customer-managed keys; Redwood will supply exported audit entries and configuration snapshots to support validation.'
Rina - security: Add 'Redwood will not bear responsibility for customer-side key rotation failures outside Redwood's managed components.'
Ivy - acct_exec: Good. OpsBot created export ticket PR-2030-11. Please ensure the CAIQ doc includes note about 'signed attestations' being an optional professional services engagement.
Samira - solutions_eng: I'll add that note and push the CAIQ answer to the questionnaire doc. ETA 2 hours.
Ivy - acct_exec: Thanks team.
